caption: The drawing depicts a long, narrow strip of cloth featuring a repeating pattern of floral and botanical elements. The background color of the strip is a beige or light tan, resembling aged fabric. The primary motif consists of various flowers, leaves, and stems, all rendered in colored pencil or thread-like lines. The flowers appear in shades of red, pink, yellow, and blue, each with detailed petals and centers. Interspersed among the flowers are green leaves and stems that curl and wind across the length of the fabric. Some leaves are broad and deeply lobed while others are slender and pointed. The composition is continuous and horizontal, with the floral and leaf elements weaving in and out along the entire strip. The overall color palette includes red, pink, yellow, blue, green, and beige.
title: Bed Valance Detail
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
